say:1:1530136401:1.text: What? No! Why would I worry about them?
say:1:1530136401:1.source_cn: 不！怎么可能？我为什么要担心呼临人？
say:1:1530136401:1.male: What? No! Why would I worry about them?
say:1:1530136401:1.female: What? No! Why would I worry about them?

say:2:1530136402:1.text: I just fear the flood might spread to Wrathwood Grove. But thinking on it, probably not.
say:2:1530136402:1.source_cn: 我担心的是洪水蔓延到树怒山谷！但我仔细想了想，应该不会。
say:2:1530136402:1.male: I just fear the flood might spread to Wrathwood Grove. But thinking on it, probably not.
say:2:1530136402:1.female: I just fear the flood might spread to Wrathwood Grove. But thinking on it, probably not.

say:3:1530136403:1.text: Still, what if they use the flood as an excuse to attack Wrathwood Grove?
say:3:1530136403:1.source_cn: 说起来，那些呼临人不会又打着洪水的借口，进攻树怒山谷吧？
say:3:1530136403:1.male: Still, what if they use the flood as an excuse to attack Wrathwood Grove?
say:3:1530136403:1.female: Still, what if they use the flood as an excuse to attack Wrathwood Grove?
